title: Q&A, Legal and Learn now say the same thing
items: The Legal page no longer says a preseason rating describes last season: it is a preseason estimate built from last season and roster changes, as the Q&A and Learn already said.
The projected score is described the same way everywhere: in football, the typical final across thousands of simulated games; in basketball, the projected margin and total split into two scores.

The Personal Ballot is described as one person's weekly ranking, not the model's. Legal now says bookmaker prices are one of the model's inputs where a game has one, matching the Q&A, and that FBS-versus-FCS games are not graded.
Learn's home-field figure now matches the football model (about three and a half points), and its model-versus-market lesson reads the current record instead of a fixed claim.
Legal no longer repeats the betting-advice disclaimer twice, and the Q&A links to the Learn tab for worked examples.
